data.one_liner: Extension methods for package:vm_service to make requests to a Dart Development Service instance.
data.what_it_does: This package expands the package:vm_service interface with support for Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs) added in the Dart Developer Service protocol. It provides extension methods allowing developers to interact with DDS features.
use_when: You need to make requests to a Dart Development Service (DDS) instance using package:vm_service.
Your debugging or tooling application requires specific RPCs defined in the DDS protocol.
avoid_when: You are building a standard Flutter application that does not involve custom developer tools or VM service extensions.
strengths: Brings support for Dart Developer Service protocol updates.
weaknesses: Niche package used specifically for tooling and VM service integration.
Some methods may become deprecated as protocols evolve.
